For bitLength=10 (mod 8 = 2), it iterates j=2,1,0 printing 3 bits, but only 2 bits (positions 0,1) are valid. The loop should start at `this.bitLength % Byte.SIZE - 1` to print only the valid bits. suspicions.observation: The isNotAck() method uses `commitOffsetBit & (1L << offsetIndex)` to check ack status. Java wraps shift amounts by mod 64 for longs. When offsetIndex >= 64 (e.g., offsetIndex=64 becomes 1L<<0=1), the wrong bit is checked. This means if offsetList has 64+ entries, messages at index >= 64 will check the wrong bit position in the commitOffsetBit long.

If all files from size()-1 down to index=1 fail the check and maxRecoverNum runs out, index will be 1 but file at index=0 was never examined. Then `mappedFiles.get(index)` at line 362 uses whatever index was found, potentially missing the first file.

bugs.observation: The isNotAck() method uses `commitOffsetBit & (1L << offsetIndex)` to check ack status. Java wraps shift amounts by mod 64 for longs. When offsetIndex >= 64 (e.g., offsetIndex=64 becomes 1L<<0=1), the wrong bit is checked. This means if offsetList has 64+ entries, messages at index >= 64 will check the wrong bit position in the commitOffsetBit long.
